# uzc_load_balancer (Resource)

Manages a UzCloud load balancer. There is no update endpoint, so changing any attribute recreates the resource; use uzc_load_balancer_rule to add rules to an existing load balancer without recreating it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_load_balancer" "example" {
  cloud_provider = "nimbo"
  network        = uzc_network.example.slug
  plan           = "load-balancer"
  name           = "example-lb"

  rules = [
    {
      name         = "http"
      public_port  = "80"
      private_port = 80
      protocol     = "tcp"
      algorithm    = "roundrobin"
      virtual_machines = [
        { slug = uzc_virtual_machine.example.slug }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `network` (String) Slug of the uzc_network to attach the load balancer to.
- `plan` (String)
- `rules` (Attributes List) Rules created alongside the load balancer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Optional

- `aquire_new_ip` (Boolean) Whether to acquire a new IP address for the load balancer. Mutually exclusive with `ipaddress` in practice.
- `billing_cycle` (String) Billing cycle slug. Falls back to the provider's `billing_cycle` default when unset.
- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider slug. Falls back to the provider's `cloud_provider` default when unset.
- `ipaddress` (String) Slug of an existing uzc_ip_address to use instead of acquiring a new one.
- `project` (String) Project slug. Falls back to the provider's `project` default when unset.
- `region` (String) Region slug. Falls back to the provider's `region` default when unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same value as `slug`. Used as the Terraform resource ID.
- `slug` (String) Server-assigned slug, used for import and by uzc_load_balancer_rule.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `algorithm` (String) e.g. "roundrobin".
- `name` (String)
- `private_port` (Number)
- `protocol` (String) e.g. "tcp", "udp", "http", "https".
- `public_port` (String)

Optional:

- `enable_proxy_protocol` (Boolean)
- `enable_tls_protocol` (Boolean)
- `sticky_method` (String) e.g. "AppCookie".
- `virtual_machines` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--virtual_machines))

<a id="nestedatt--rules--virtual_machines"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.virtual_machines`

Required:

- `slug` (String)

Optional:

- `ipaddress` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_load_balancer.example <load-balancer-slug>
```
